concept: One colleague, one desk, one path of doors: Maya notices a dinner claimed twice, feels the pull to stay quiet, weighs it with three questions, and finds the right door, even when the first door is the wrong one. The facts sit on things in her world (receipts, a notepad, door signs).

story.metaphor: channels as doors along a path from your desk
story.setting: Maya's finance office and the path of doors beside it
story.arc: notice, pull to stay quiet, weigh, choose a door, the twist, the calm note

cast.name: Maya
cast.role: finance employee, the only person in b01 to b11; front view, stands on the right third at her desk, on the left third on the path

devices.what: Maya's finance desk in her office: the desk edge in front of her, laptop, phone, the two matching dinner receipts with the duplicate circled; one set for the whole story, b11 mirrors b01
three paper thought bubbles rising over Maya, each carrying one reason to stay quiet, dimming as she straightens
a paper notepad on her desk: three questions written one line at a time, then ticked against the receipts
a path leading from her desk past five labelled doors (Manager, Another manager, HR, Compliance, Speak-up line); one set changed by state: doors appear, the manager's greys out, the others light up
the one join material: a paper page turn into and out of the off-story beats

value_script.why: the open: warm paper, daylight office, one accent on the duplicate
a slightly richer middle as she weighs it and the channels open
the twist: the manager's door greys and the path dims, broken for meaning
the other doors light up, then the calm desk: the lift at the close

parts.what: Maya's finance office desk set: a surface2 wall with one window, a standing-height desk whose near edge sits in front of Maya (field2 front, hides her below the waist, its top line 40 px or more clear of her hip and hem), a laptop facing her (states: expense sheet, mail compose, closed), a phone on the desk, two matching dinner receipts side by side (same restaurant 'Harbour Grill', same 'Team dinner' line, same total) with a circle state (none, drawn: an accent ring round the second receipt's total, the only accent in the set), and a magnifying glass (states: lying by the receipts, absent). No accent furniture, no shelf books. Two framings: medium (Maya scale about 0.85) and close (scale about 1.5, receipts at the lower frame edge).

a paper notepad lying on the desk_set's desk, ink outline, three lines in Nunito body: 'Breaks a rule?', 'Harms someone?', 'Fine in public?'; states per line: hidden, written (unmasked left to right), ticked (a pos tick shape beside it).

the channel path: a paper floor path running from the corner of Maya's desk (left edge, the tie to desk_set) to the right past five doors in perspective, each door an outlined surface door with a hand-lettered sign (Patrick Hand 400): 'Manager', 'Another manager', 'HR', 'Compliance', 'Speak-up line'. States per door: hidden, standing, signed, greyed (muted fill, sign faded to 0.4, a small cross on the sign), lit (door ajar, warm honey light spilling on the path). The path line has states: to the fork, past the greyed door to the lit doors. A dim state for the whole set (darker wall) for b09. Space on the left third for Maya at medium-wide scale with her feet behind the path's near kerb.

design.subject: two matching dinner receipts on Maya's desk
design.treatment: Maya at her desk (desk_set, medium), the two receipts land side by side, the duplicate is circled, she reaches for the phone and pulls her hand back
design.why_motion: the hesitation is the story: a reach and a retreat says the pull to stay quiet before any word does

elements.name: desk
elements.what: desk_set desk, near edge in front of Maya

elements.name: receipt_circle
elements.what: accent ring round the duplicate total

beat_sheet.action: settles at her desk, focus
two receipts slide in side by side
accent ring draws round the second receipt's total
hand-lettered note 'Something doesn't add up' pinned on the wall
hand reaches toward the phone
pulls the hand back, uneasy

design.continuity: desk set, receipts and Maya stay for b02

design.subject: Maya's uneasy face
design.treatment: a cut to a close on Maya's uneasy face, the circled receipt at the lower edge; she looks from the receipts up to the viewer
design.why_motion: the reaction is the point: her look turns the question to the viewer

elements.name: receipts
elements.what: receipts at the lower frame edge

elements.name: maya
elements.what: Maya rig, close, brow to chin 250 px or more

beat_sheet.action: eyes down at the receipts, uneasy
looks up to the viewer, a small resolved breath and a slight nod

design.continuity: same desk set at close framing; b03 cuts back to the medium

design.subject: three thought bubbles over Maya
design.treatment: back to the medium: three paper thought bubbles rise over Maya one per question, then dim as she straightens
design.why_motion: the reasons arrive one after another and then lose their hold: the rise and the dimming carry that

elements.name: bubble_cost
elements.what: thought bubble 'What will it cost me?'

beat_sheet.action: shoulders drop, thoughtful
bubble 'What if I'm wrong?' rises
bubble 'What will it cost me?' rises
bubble 'Not my business' rises
straightens up; the three bubbles dim to 0.35

design.continuity: bubbles leave before b04; desk, receipts and Maya held

design.subject: a magnifying glass set down on the desk
design.treatment: Maya sets a magnifying glass down by the receipts; a card pinned on her wall reads 'Honest belief, not proof': 'proof' is struck and fades, 'Honest belief' stays in accent
design.why_motion: putting the glass down is the refutation: investigating is not her job

elements.name: rule_card
elements.what: card pinned on the wall, left third

elements.name: belief_words
elements.what: 'Honest belief' in accent on the card

elements.name: proof_word
elements.what: 'not proof' in ink on the card

beat_sheet.action: card drops onto the wall, left third
struck through with an ink line
'Honest belief' stamps in accent
Maya lowers the glass to the desk and lets go
'not proof' fades to 0.3

design.continuity: the card leaves at the end; the magnifier stays on the desk

design.subject: a notepad of three questions on the desk
design.treatment: the question_pad lands on the desk beside the receipts, tilted up toward the viewer, and its three lines write in one at a time as each question is asked; Maya tilts her head per question
design.why_motion: each question appears on its word: the list is built as she thinks it

elements.name: receipt_circle
elements.what: the accent ring, redrawn faint (0.5) so the pad heading carries the accent

beat_sheet.action: notepad slides onto the desk, a small heading 'Three questions' in accent
'Breaks a rule?' writes in
'Harms someone?' writes in
'Fine in public?' writes in
head tilt, weighing

design.subject: ticks on the notepad against the receipts
design.treatment: the pad's lines tick one after another as the circled receipt's ring redraws to full strength (the ring sits inside the held receipts); Maya nods, decided
design.why_motion: the ticks landing against the receipt is the judgement being made

elements.name: pad_ticks
elements.what: three pos tick shapes beside the pad lines

elements.name: receipt_circle
elements.what: the accent ring inside the held receipts, tweened back to full strength

beat_sheet.action: the ring redraws once round the duplicate
three pos ticks land, staggered
firm nod, decided face

design.continuity: the camera pans right to the path in b07

design.subject: five labelled doors along a path
design.treatment: the camera pans right from her desk: the door_path opens, Maya at its start on the left third, five doors standing up one at a time along it, each sign lettered as it is named, her manager's first
design.why_motion: the channels arrive in the order she would meet them: the path is the sequence

elements.name: path_set
elements.what: door_path wall, floor and desk corner

elements.name: door_line
elements.what: door 'Speak-up line' with tag 'anonymous where offered'

beat_sheet.action: the path draws from the desk corner to the right
first door stands up, sign 'Manager' in accent as the easiest start
door 'Another manager' stands up; the Manager sign returns to ink
door 'HR' stands up
door 'Compliance' stands up
door 'Speak-up line' stands up
a small tag 'anonymous where offered' hangs on the last sign
turns to present the doors, palm up

design.continuity: the path and doors return in b09 in the same layout

design.subject: the manager's door greyed out at a fork
design.treatment: back on the same path, dimmed: the manager's door greys out, Maya stands at the fork, a hanging sign over the fork asks the question; the frame holds for the 3 s pause
design.why_motion: the greying door is the twist; the hold gives the viewer time to answer

elements.name: question_sign
elements.what: hanging sign 'Her manager is involved. Where now?', the question in accent

beat_sheet.action: goes grey, sign fades, small cross on it
worried face
sign 'Her manager is involved. Where now?' drops over the fork
looks along the path, thinking, a slow tilt in the pause

design.continuity: the greyed door and the doors held into b10

design.subject: the other doors lighting up
design.treatment: the set brightens, the question sign lifts away, the other doors open and light up one by one, and the path line runs past the grey door to them; Maya turns to them with an open hand. Each door keeps its own sign (and the last its tag) and the path keeps its fork and route strokes: they ride on the held doors and path as followers, so they must not vanish at the join
design.why_motion: light moving past the grey door is the answer: there is always another door

design.subject: a sent note and a sticky note on her wall
design.treatment: the opening shot returns exactly: Maya at her desk, relaxed now; she sends a short note on the laptop (mail compose: 'To: Compliance', 'Subject: A duplicate expense claim') and closes it; a sticky note on the wall reads 'Notice. Weigh. Speak up.'
design.why_motion: the mirror of b01 shows the change: the same desk, a calm person, a sent note
